name: Waters of Xavian
summary: Waters of Xavian is a Horde mage quest offered by Deino in Orgrimmar. Seeking to plumb ancient elven secrets, she tasks her apprentice with traveling to the ruins of Xavian in Ashenvale to draw a sample from its highest waterfall.

sections.title: A Mage's Curiosity
sections.body: Within the dark crevices of the Valley of Spirits, the troll mage Deino seeks out lingering reservoirs of primal arcane energy across Kalimdor. Her gaze turns to Xavian, an ancient night elf city hidden deep in the eastern canopy of Ashenvale. Legends among scholars whisper that the city was steeped in magical knowledge before the Sundering, and its waters are said to retain potent arcane properties that modern casters yearn to dissect.

sections.title: The Ruins of Xavian
sections.body: Reaching the source of these waters is no simple errand. Xavian no longer belongs to peaceful elven sages; it has fallen into ruin and is now overrun by feral, corrupt satyrs who fiercely guard their territory from outsiders. Prying mages must navigate past Satyrnaar and tread through dangerous waterways, avoiding both prowling beasts and demonic sentinels to fill Deino's flask at the base of the city's towering waterfall.

faq.answer: Deino is a troll mage trainer and scholar located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. She instructs Horde mages and investigates relics of ancient Kalimdor magic.
Xavian is an ancient ruined city situated in northeastern Ashenvale, north of Splintertree Post and just northwest of the satyr stronghold of Satyrnaar.

faq.q: Why does Deino want this water?
faq.answer: Scholarly accounts claim Xavian once held vast magical knowledge, and its waters are believed to hold lingering arcane power. Deino wants a fresh sample from the waterfall's source to analyze its properties.

faq.q: What dangers guard the ruins of Xavian?
faq.answer: The ruins are infested with satyrs—demonic, corrupted beings who despise trespassers and guard their territory aggressively against prying mages.

faq.q: Where exactly is the water sample collected?
faq.answer: The sample must be scooped into Deino's flask from the pool at the very base of the highest waterfall within the ruins of Xavian.

faq.q: What comes next after returning the sample to Deino?
aliases: next quest after waters of xavian
faq.answer: Satisfied with the water sample, Deino sends the mage on the next stage of study involving the dryads in Ashenvale with the quest Laughing Sisters.

angles.text: This quest is an exclusive rite of study for Horde mages, testing their ability to venture into hostile wilderness to extract untamed arcane reagents.
Splintertree Post serves as the Horde's nearest staging ground in eastern Ashenvale for navigating the satyr-infested wilds surrounding Xavian.
